rule: ground truth = ids reported non-French at confidence >= 0.25 by the published incident analysis; baseline = historical detectLanguage(title + summary); delivered = incidentAdmissionVerdict(title, summary, RADAR_LANGUAGES=fr); correct = language matches the ground truth (fr or en)

sql.incidents:
SELECT e.id::text AS id, e.title, e.summary, e.assertion_type, e.regional,
         o.dept AS department, e.source_id
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN org o ON o.id = e.org_id
   WHERE e.assertion_type IN ('confirmed_incident', 'third_party_claim')
     AND (e.regional OR o.dept IN ('16', '17', '19', '23', '24', '33', '40', '47', '64', '79', '86', '87'))
   ORDER BY e.id
